Beale 0.9.1 is the first signed Desktop release for macOS and Windows.

- macOS: Developer ID signed and Apple notarized ARM64 DMG and ZIP.
- Windows: Azure Artifact Signing signed x64 installer, with publisher and timestamp checks.
- Both platforms include the Beale app-server runtime and update feed files. Updates download only when requested in Beale.
- Release assets include `SHA256SUMS.txt` for download verification.

This release also includes continuous research tracks, custom OpenAI compatible provider endpoints, and session and workspace improvements. See `CHANGELOG.md` at the `v0.9.1` tag for details.

Beale and app-server run with your current host privileges. Run risky target code inside an operator managed VM or container when OS isolation is needed.
